resources.string: Sample mode · works without a token

You can test accounts and saved movies in sample mode. For live search and mood recommendations, obtain your own API Read Access Token from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api and paste it below. The token is saved privately on this device and is never added to the project source. Saved movies remain available offline.
Save token and enable live movies
Paste the complete Read Access Token without spaces
Token saved. Search will verify it with TMDB.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.\nhttps://www.themoviedb.org\nSample mode uses six locally supplied movie descriptions. Mood suggestions use genre rules and are not mental health advice.
